shortDescription: Generate JSON/XML schema and tree representation for given YANG model

options.name: content
options.description: The text content of the top level YANG model for the the should be generated. This option is mutually-exclusive with C(path) option.

options.name: doctype
options.description: Identifies the root node of the configuration skeleton. If value is C(config) only configuration data will be present in skeleton, if value is C(data) both config and state data fields will be present in output.

options.name: file
options.description: The file path of the top level YANG model for the spec should be generated. This option is mutually-exclusive with C(content) option.

options.name: json_schema
options.description: The options to control the way JSON schema is generated

options.name: search_path
options.description: is a colon C(:) separated list of directories to search for imported yang modules in the yang file mentioned in C(path) option. If the value is not given it will search in the default directory path.

options.name: tree_schema
options.description: The options to control the way tree schema is generated

options.name: xml_schema
options.description: The options to control the way XML schema is generated
